body:
Thank you for your submission.

I don't understand what the proposed license text is meant to be, since the LICENSE URL linked above appears to just be a copy of AGPL-3.0.

However, from a quick look at the Comments section, it appears your intent is to have some sort of a source-available, non-open-source license (e.g. "Non-Commercial Use Only").

It also appears that this is your own personal license, and has not been used by anyone else. (In fact, the only project linked as an example project doesn't appear to use it either, as mentioned above).

Given that, this will not be added to the SPDX License List. Please review the [SPDX License Inclusion Principles](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-XML/blob/main/DOCS/license-inclusion-principles.md) and other issues in this repo that have been closed for similar reasons.
